audit_reference: 10.6A Five-Country Canonical Coverage Audit Correction v1
verdict: Automation CAN start now for AU/GB/CA/IE institution+course and AU occupation workloads; US and IE occupations require additional data source work first (GAP-005, GAP-006). Counts referenced are public_legacy_view_count / api_private_read_model_count; canonical_database_count is null for all countries.

AU: CRICOS snapshot -> canonical (currently ad-hoc python into public)
US: College Scorecard API -> institutions/programmes (key present in .env.local)

gitignore_related.note: cricos_* (AU), hea_* (GB), qualifax_* (IE) repo-root files are gitignored, so raw snapshots are not versioned. Under WP-03 3-tier policy: Git holds manifests/checksums/sample fixtures (Tier A), large raw snapshots go to object storage (Tier B), restricted-licence sources are re-download only (Tier C). data/raw/{country} folder presence is NOT a success criterion.
gitignore_related.risk: source lineage cannot be reproduced from repo alone until Tier A manifests are committed

runtime_dependencies.origin_comparison_tables: GAP-007 verified: concept_career_mappings, career_compensation_observations, housing_cost_observations, country_comparison_coverage return PGRST205 (404) - migration_not_applied; runtime degrades gracefully (verified). Automation must not assume these are observable; verify before 10.7 ingestion (WP-05).
runtime_dependencies.api_private: server-only read model; automation for non-AU read models is out of scope until v1.1

prerequisites_before_automation: Establish WP-01 canonical read-only audit observability (psql read-only / SQL editor SELECT-only / admin-only audit script; canonical schemas stay private)
Commit Tier A source manifests + checksums under data/source-manifests/{country}/{source}/ (WP-03)
Establish canonical GB naming (uk-* fixtures vs gb-*) during GB OfS integration (WP-06)
GAP-007: verify origin-comparison tables at runtime and record apply-migration / backfill / de-scope decision (WP-05)

recommended_first_automation.priority_1: AU CRICOS snapshot ingestion into catalog via canonical pipeline (replaces ad-hoc public writes)
